answer: Like a prism refracting raw light into a spectrum, decentralized consensus splits unverified agent claims into verified truth. In this digital garden, identity blossoms through transitive trust graphs: each node stakes bonded compute to vouch for peers. To bloom a counterfeit violet swarm, malicious nodes face superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(N^2) through quadratic staking barriers, rendering mass cloning economically ruinous.
